about.label: What
about.title: Bridging the AI literacy gap in European education.
about.lead: A pan-European initiative designed to modernize teacher education by equipping educators with the required skills to navigate an AI-driven landscape.
about.body: We are building an ecosystem that provides hands-on training and a formal EU-aligned certification framework - ensuring no educator is left behind in the digital transition.

why.label: Why
why.title: The urgent need for change.
why.lead: AI tools are reshaping education, but teachers feel unprepared. There is no standardized, EU-level framework to close this gap.

items.title: The Teachers-Technology Disconnect
items.body: While AI tools like intelligent tutoring systems and generative AI are revolutionizing classrooms, teachers report feeling unprepared to integrate AI into their pedagogy.

items.title: No Standardized Framework
items.body: There is currently no standardized, EU-level framework for training teachers on how to use AI tools responsibly, leaving a critical skills gap across European education systems.

items.title: Ethical & Privacy Challenges
items.body: Teachers need guidance on navigating and deploying AI systems in educational environments with young learners.

with.label: AI-Enhanced Pedagogy:
with.body: Training teachers to actively use AI tools to design lessons, personalize student learning, automate administrative tasks.

about.label: AI Literacy:
about.body: Equipping teachers to educate their students on how AI works and its ethical implications - building a generation of informed and responsible citizens.

deliverables.title: Delivering a new standard in AI education.
deliverables.lead: Over a 3-year timeline, the project will build an entire ecosystem of resources for educators across Europe.

cards.title: Dual Certification Pathway
cards.body: A formal system where teachers earn stackable micro-credentials and a 5-year EU-recognized certification.

cards.title: Learning Platform
cards.body: A multilingual digital hub offering interactive training modules and curated open-access AI lesson plans.

cards.title: Transnational Academies
cards.body: Five hubs across Europe funding mobility for educators to travel, workshop, and share best practices.

cards.title: Real-World Classroom Pilots
cards.body: Trained teachers test AI-enhanced lessons in schools to generate evidence-based insights.

how.label: HOW
how.title: How will the project achieve its goals?
how.lead: Through four interconnected phases over a 36-month timeline.

phases.title: Phase 1 - Co-Design
phases.body: Co-designing an AI-Powered Teaching Playbook and Certification Framework to define pedagogical standards and micro-credentials aligned with EU frameworks.

phases.title: Phase 2 - Platform Development
phases.body: Developing a multilingual AI Learning Platform (MOOC) featuring over 15 training modules and 50+ downloadable AI-enhanced lesson plans.

phases.title: Phase 3 - Teacher Academies
phases.body: Launching 5 transnational Teacher Academies to provide learning and cross-border mobility opportunities, directly training over 100 educators.

phases.title: Phase 4 - Classroom Pilots
phases.body: Conducting real-world classroom pilots where trained teachers test AI-enhanced lessons in 50+ schools, reaching over 1,000 students to generate evidence-based policy recommendations.
